posts.title: Starting the garden
posts.summary: Why this page exists: short notes on papers, ideas, and tools I keep coming back to — tended together with my OpenClaw agents.

posts.title: Interactive SOAP explainer
posts.summary: The SOAP descriptor built up step by step — atomic density, spherical harmonics, the power spectrum, and how mu1nu1 compression shrinks it — with live 3D widgets and shareable embeds.

posts.title: Interactive MatterVial explainer
posts.summary: How MatterVial gives feature-based models the representations GNNs learn — latent features, SISSO formulas, an interpreter, and static element embeddings — as a clickable chapter walkthrough with live widgets.

posts.title: Interactive VibroML explainer
posts.summary: VibroML finds imaginary phonons with machine-learned potentials and follows the soft modes downhill to dynamically stable polymorphs — pipeline, detection metrics, GA vs single-path remediation, and 6,574-system scale results.

posts.title: Interactive ProtoCSP explainer
posts.summary: ProtoCSP turns a prototype and a target composition into ranked, ordered crystal structures — cold-start prototype borrowing, alloy decoration, fast tensor mode, and MLIP relaxation, all explorable chapter by chapter.

posts.title: Interactive MEIDNet explainer
posts.summary: MEIDNet (lead: Anand Babu) generates crystals from target properties via a multimodal contrastive latent space — architecture, latent search, benchmark results, and the VibroML repair loop that followed.

posts.title: Interactive modnet-pt explainer
posts.summary: modnet-pt rewrites MODNet in PyTorch behind the scikit-learn contract — featurization, FRR selection, joint learning, preset and genetic search, ensembles — with confirmed parity on matbench_dielectric.
